meta.title: Independence County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Independence County's 2026 budget, set by Ordinance 2025-26 and filed with the state. Amounts are what the ordinance appropriates for each fund; the split of each general fund office comes from the 2026 budget worksheets. Some money moves between county funds, so it shows up twice: for example, the Road Fund sends $894,000 to the Four Lane Highway Fund, and the general fund sends $143,750 to 9-1-1 and the public defender.

nodes.name: County Sheriff
nodes.note: The ordinance appropriates $2,325,096.00; the categories on the 2026 budget worksheet add to $2,325,081.00.
